column1: # The twin regime's placement frontier (entered 2026-09-02 with the §6.5
# DEFAULT FLIP — rollback-and-replay is the only regime; found by the
# variation lane, test/go/langspec/vary_differential_test.go). Every row
# is GREEN on the interpreter and refuses to compile at Finalize's
# full-placement gate: the check pass performs a bind transition inside a
# wrapped body that no compiled op replays or installs, so the rollback
# would lose it. The old keep-installs default compiled these on the check
# pass's own leftover install — which is the divergence class the regime
# exists to eliminate, so the refusal is the sound direction. Four shapes,
# each its own graduation:
#   1. an `import` inside a MULTI-RUN body — a module bind is not one of
#      the BindDef twins the arm-residency bridge installs per element;
#   2. a TYPE def inside a multi-run body — the bridge pairs BindDef twins
#      only (a type twin declines the whole bridge);
#   3. a `do` body whose CLOSURE compile declines (a Stage-3 residual
#      shape: literals under a branch result), so the once-run body's
#      twins are never adopted — `do [def b true (if b [] [9 9])]` and
#      `do [def b true 1 2 b]` compile, this one does not;
#   4. a call into a boru-IMPLEMENTED module (`Sift.parse`, sift.boru)
#      inside the `do` body that imported it leaves a twin the do-body
#      adoption declines. MEASURED, not yet root-caused: `import
#      "boru:sift" do [(Sift.parse …)]` compiles (import outside), and
#      so does `do [import "boru:sift" Sift.parse]` (no call) — it is
#      the import-and-call pair inside one once-run body that refuses.
# Graduation = resident module binds / resident type twins inside compiled
# units (1, 2), a closure lowering that admits the declined body (3), and
# the root cause of (4) found and closed; each row then moves to the main
# corpus.
[10 20] each [drop import "boru:math-util" end MathUtil.cbrt 2]
column3: shape 1: an import inside an each body

column3: shape 3: a do body whose closure compile declines, so its def twin is never adopted
